summary.headline: Aries Birth Prognostics
summary.text: A rhetorical preface contrasts legal learning with philosophy and higher sciences, mentioning purgations for quinsy and pleurisy; it then opens prognostics from the zodiac with the appearance and character of a person born under Aries. A note identifies a shorter parallel version in Codex Bononiensis 18 and dates this recension to the fifteenth century.
